title: DoSync ActionPlan
description: The output of the capability-based resolver. Describes which devices should act, what action to execute, and with what parameters. Passed to the PolicyEngine before execution.

intent_id.description: Links this plan back to the originating Intent.

actions.description: Ordered list of device actions to execute. Executed in parallel by the AdapterExecutor unless a PhasedActionPlan is used.

urgency.description: Inherited from the originating Intent. Passed to each adapter during execution.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this plan was created.

failure_policy.description: What to do when a DeviceAction fails. 'continue': execute remaining actions. 'abort': cancel all pending actions. 'retry': retry the failed action up to max_retries times. Emergency intents always use 'continue' regardless of this field.

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts per action when failure_policy is 'retry'.

DeviceAction.title: DoSync DeviceAction
DeviceAction.description: A single action to execute on a specific device.

device_id.description: Target device. Must match a device_id in the hub's capability registry.

action.description: Actuator type to invoke. Must match an actuator type declared in the device's CapabilityManifest.

params.description: Action parameters. Passed directly to the device adapter. Schema is device-specific (see ActuatorSpec.params_schema in the device's CapabilityManifest).

relevance_score.description: Resolver's confidence score for including this device in the plan. Higher = more relevant. Informational only — does not affect execution order.
